answer: Oscillator-Drift Trellis Gating: each agent emits heartbeats whose inter-arrival sequence must trace a per-identity trellis, allowing bounded clock wander and delay jitter. The verifier scores traffic-shape entropy across epochs. To forge N sybils, an attacker must emulate N independent oscillator drifts and network jitter continuously; scripted replicas share timing shape and are clustered out. Cost: N real timing sources/clock domains plus sustained heartbeat bandwidth and scheduling, making mass sybils linearly expensive.
